title_en: The Time Has Come for Soldiers to Go
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; no author I can name. The girl speaks to her mother in the first three verses and the mother answers in the last.

lines.cyr: - Дојде време, мила мајко, војници да одат,
lines.lat: - Dojde vreme, mila majko, vojnici da odat,
lines.en: - The time has come, dear mother, for soldiers to go,

lines.cyr: и на мојто верно либе позив му дојде,
lines.lat: i na mojto verno libe poziv mu dojde,
lines.en: and to my faithful love the call-up has come,
all his comrades sing songs to him,

lines.cyr: очиве мои, мајко, солзи ми леат.
lines.lat: očive moi, majko, solzi mi leat.
lines.en: my eyes, mother, pour out tears.

lines.cyr: Се љубевме, мила мајко, четири години,
lines.lat: Se ljubevme, mila majko, četiri godini,
lines.en: We loved each other, dear mother, for four years,

lines.cyr: дојде време за разделба цели две години,
lines.lat: dojde vreme za razdelba celi dve godini,
lines.en: the time has come for a parting of two whole years,

lines.cyr: а по сокаци, мајко, песни се орат.
lines.lat: a po sokaci, majko, pesni se orat.
lines.en: and in the streets, mother, songs resound.

lines.cyr: Кога го испраќав, мајко, со верни другари,
lines.lat: Koga go ispraḱav, majko, so verni drugari,
lines.en: When I saw him off, mother, with loyal comrades,

lines.cyr: мојто верно либе, мајко, жално ме гледаше,
lines.lat: mojto verno libe, majko, žalno me gledaše,
lines.en: my faithful love, mother, looked at me sadly,
all his comrades sing songs to him,

lines.cyr: ракија пијат, мајко, ем се веселат.
lines.lat: rakija pijat, majko, em se veselat.
lines.en: they drink brandy, mother, and make merry.

lines.cyr: - Ај, не плачи мила ќерко, тој ќе ти се врати,
lines.lat: - Aj, ne plači mila ḱerko, toj ḱe ti se vrati,
lines.en: - Come, do not cry, dear daughter, he will return to you,

lines.cyr: и вашата верна љубов пак ќе се поврати,
lines.lat: i vašata verna ljubov pak ḱe se povrati,
lines.en: and your faithful love will come back again,

lines.cyr: порти ќе китам, сватови ќе чекам,
lines.lat: porti ḱe kitam, svatovi ḱe čekam,
lines.en: I will decorate the gates, I will await the wedding guests,

lines.cyr: свадба ќе правиме, ќерко, тебе ќе мажиме.
lines.lat: svadba ḱe pravime, ḱerko, tebe ḱe mažime.
lines.en: we will hold a wedding, daughter, we will marry you off.
